definitions.full: H5170. nachar [ נַ֫חַר ] noun [masculine] a snorting ; suffix נַחְרוֺ Job 39:20 (of horse). [ נַחֲרָה ] noun feminine id.; — construct סוּסָיו נַחֲרַת Jer 8:16 .
definitions.rootNote: and (feminine) נַחֲרָה ; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore ;
